pit_message_severity

Lookup-table for message severities.

Fields
pse_id

Technical Key.

pse_name

Unique name for message severity.

pse_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, display name.

pse_pti_pmg_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, item group. Only allowed value is PIT.

pse_requires_exception

Flag to indicate whether the severity requires that an exception is created for it. Possible values: NONE - No exception, OPTIONAL - may have an exception, MANDATORY - must have an exception.
